title: Part Twelve: The Shield in Office, 2017–2026

sections.brief: Trump's 6 Dec 2017 statement and its stated reasons; Pence at CUFI 2017 ('only when'); 14 May 2018 opening with Jeffress's opening prayer and Hagee's benediction, Romney's objection, both pastors' defences, Gaza deaths the same day; drivers of the move side by side (1995 Act, campaign promise, Trump's 2020 'for the evangelicals', Adelson gifts); Golan Proclamation 9852 stated reasons; Pompeo's 18 Nov 2019 settlements statement, Blinken's 2024 reversal, Trump's Sept 2025 'will not allow' annexation; Guatemala, Honduras (2021; 2022 reconsideration), Paraguay, Brazil in brief. Figures: time; compare

Each official's stated reason, as said: Pence 'hand of heaven' (2017); Pompeo's Esther answer (CBN, 21 Mar 2019); Friedman at the Pilgrimage Road (30 Jun 2019) and on Cruz's 'nation of Israel'; Huckabee (confirmed 9 Apr 2025; Palestinian state June 2025; Feb 2026 'take it all' and walk-back; MOU talks); Johnson at Ariel (4 Aug 2025) and on Genesis 12:3, Track AIPAC money (not motive); Hegseth's 2018 Temple remark; Cruz June 2025; what the record shows and does not; dropped claims listed.
